title: 3 programming languages that will die by 2028

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know three programming languages will be extinct by 2028?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just tech trivia — it’s a career shift for thousands of developers.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: COBOL, Visual Basic 6, and Perl are the ones heading toward obsolescence.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: COBOL still powers 70% of global financial transactions but lacks modern updates.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Legacy systems using these languages will become too costly to maintain.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Adapt or get left behind in the tech race.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s your take? Will you be ready when the dust settles?
